facts.metadata_preflight: reads filename from source map; writes selected metadata to separate output map
facts.complete_map_branch: requires samples already present before fallback

minimum_runtime_token: DDP context pointer loaded from callback receiver +0xb8 and passed unchanged as initializer receiver; track its identity/generation to first source-map samples write and complete-map check.
audio_boundary: Source metadata ownership only; no audio algorithm/value. Do not infer from key name or scalar equality.
